    static class GTakeMetro {
        int step(int n, long t, int s, int m) {
            int curJump = (int) (t % n);
            int sign = s < m ? 1 : -1;
            s += sign * curJump;
            s %= n;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
            return s;
        }

        int doLoop(int s, long t, int n, int m) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

                s = step(n, t--, s, m);
            }
            
            long[] lastSeen = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(lastSeen, -1);
            int round = 0;
            
            while (t != 0) {
                s = doLoop(s, t, n, m);

                    t %= interval;
                    break;
                } else {
                    lastSeen[s] = round++;
                }
            }

            }

        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
